ttm.tr: Son 12 ay = 2025 yılı kârı + Ocak-Eylül 2026 kârı − Ocak-Eylül 2025 kârı, hepsi Eylül 2026 parasıyla. 2025 yılı kârı (3.376 milyon TL, Aralık 2025 parası) şirketin kendi düzeltme katsayılarıyla Eylül 2026 parasına çevrildi (4.197 milyon TL). Enflasyon muhasebesi nedeniyle çeyrekler toplanmadı.
ttm.en: Last 12 months = full-year 2025 profit + January-September 2026 profit − January-September 2025 profit, all in September 2026 money. Full-year 2025 profit (TL 3,376 million in December 2025 money) was carried to September 2026 money with the company's own restatement coefficients (TL 4,197 million). Quarters were not added because of inflation accounting.

TBORG.notes: 12-month net profit is my arithmetic, not a company figure: 4,596.870 (9M26) + 4,197.002 (FY2025 restated) - 4,896.885 (9M25) = 3,896.987. FY2025 3,376,019 thousand TL (primary, 2025 statements) x 1.1776 (Dec 2025 -> Jun 2026 coefficient, primary: note 2.1 of the 30 Jun 2026 statements; index 110.39 -> 129.99) x 1.05569 (Jun -> Sep 2026; NOT read from a document: implied by 6M26 profit 2,085,116 restated so that 9M - Q3 holds, and it reproduces the prior-year Q3 to within 15 thousand TL). 9M figures come from news reports of the KAP filing (notice 1695650), not from the filing itself, which could not be opened. Check against the source: market cap 39,636 / P/E 10.2 = 3,886; document-based 3,897 (0.3% apart). EPS null: no 12-month EPS is reported; shares are 32,250,825,300 of 1 kurus (322.5 million per TL 1 nominal), company reports EPS per 100 shares (6M26: 6.47). On a TL 1 nominal share the 12-month figure would be about 12.08 TL (my arithmetic). tax_rate = 9M26 (6,599,680 pre-tax - 4,596,870 net) / pre-tax, from Borsatek's table of the KAP filing. One-offs: none identified by the company. To check when the 9M notes open: Law 7582 cuts the corporate tax rate on production earnings to 12.5% from 1 Jan 2027 and the 6M26 statements say deferred tax measurement was affected; 6M26 deferred tax income was 220,952 thousand TL in total, the part due to the rate change is not disclosed, so nothing was deducted. No disposal gains seen; investment income is interest and FX gains (2025: interest 2,339,622, FX gains 603,674). No profit guidance.
